execution: Static design review only; no source edits, detached checkout operations, process control, PG or test execution by reviewer.
required_constraints: Record actual imported module paths and hashes per process as well as commit IDs. Detached parent must not accidentally import current src through PYTHONPATH or cached modules. Same common tests/conftest/fault fixture/version/order and execution settings.

Predeclare four bounded AB/BA runs; do not select extra retries because of observed outcome. Independent owned schemas and minimum CRUD roles; preserve identities without logging connection strings or passwords.

Wrapper calls original methods exactly once and preserves return/exception, especially Worker.once boolean; no lease/timeout/retry modification. Durable child trace before os._exit; state that trace I/O/fsync/sampling changes timing.

Trace wall and monotonic times, claim/heartbeat/guard start/end and safe original returned state/fence/lease. Prefer existing driver backend PID attributes. Do not add introspection SQL to the original mutation transaction.

pg_stat_activity/lock samples restricted to the owned role/schema and known backend PIDs; no query text, query parameters, environment or raw SQLAlchemy exception representation. Error class/public code only.

Snapshot before fixture teardown only owned schema synthetic Run states, event kind and explicitly whitelisted safe metadata, operation states. Do not dump resource bytes, input/output, message, receipt or credentials.

Instrumented all PASS is bounded nonreproduction, not timing attribution. A diagnosed cause needs matching actual stage/lease/guard/heartbeat events. Preserve original uninstrumented full failure and focused pass logs.
conclusion: No design blocker if these constraints are implemented. Implementation and evidence still require independent review; full PostgreSQL aggregate remains failed until a separately completed passing run.
